info.title: M2: executar smoke HTTP das cinco rotas

parts.text: "Execute na pasta api dart run tool/smoke_m2.dart e registre resultado/exit real. Script ja inicia e encerra somente seu servidor filho MODO_TESTE=1 PORT3000. Nao altere lib/server.dart nem testes nem frontend: persistencia sendo implementada em outra sessao. Se smoke falhar, leia contrato/spec e diagnostique se fixture do SCRIPT incorreta; so pode corrigir script quando demonstrar erro fixture, mantendo exigencias contrato/spec e relatando ajuste. Se defeito API registre para agente principal sem consertar. Se alterar somente script rode dart analyze tool/smoke_m2.dart e commit apenas script sem no-verify/push. Nao concluir se processo ainda rodando: aguarde terminar e verifique porta liberada. Nao finalize pedindo autorizacao ja concedida."

parts.text:
Let me understand the task:

1. Execute `dart run tool/smoke_m2.dart` in the api folder and register the real result/exit code
2. The script starts and ends only its own child server with MODO_TESTE=1 PORT3000
3. Don't alter lib/server.dart, tests, or frontend
4. If smoke fails, read contract/spec and diagnose if the fixture in the SCRIPT is incorrect; can only correct the script when demonstrating fixture error, keeping contract/spec requirements and reporting the adjustment
5. If API defect, register for the main agent without fixing
6. If only changing script, run `dart analyze tool/smoke_m2.dart` and commit only script
7. Don't conclude if process still running: wait for termination and verify port is freed
8. Don't finalize asking for authorization already granted
